questions.stem: Which of the following would NOT increase the induced voltage when moving a magnet into a coil?

options.text: Using a thicker wire for the coil
Using a coil with more turns

questions.explanation: Using a thicker wire reduces the resistance of the coil but does not increase the induced voltage. The induced voltage increases with faster movement, a stronger magnet, or more turns on the coil, because all of these increase the rate of change of magnetic flux.
